newsitem.title: USA: Liquor ads air on New Hampshire TV stations - report.
newsitem.headline: Liquor ads air on New Hampshire TV stations - report.

text.p: Two New Hampshire television stations began airing advertisements for Chivas Regal and Crown Royal whiskeys, produced by Seagram Co Ltd, in a break with a nearly 50-year-old tradition, The Boston Herald reported Tuesday.

Both WNDS-TV, an independent station based in Derry, N.H., which also reaches viewers in northeastern Massachusetts, and WMUR-TV, a Manchester, N.H.-based ABC network affiliate, have agreed to run the ads, the Herald said.

WNDS-TV general sales manager Marc Lehner told the newspaper, "We are running them. There's no law prohibiting it. The ads are done very tastefully and contain a statement about drinking responsibly."

For nearly 50 years, the makers of distilled spirits voluntarily refrained from television advertising, but last spring, the Montreal-based Seagram's broke with the pack when it ran a commercial on Chivas on a Texas station, the newspaper reported.
Spokesmen for the television stations and Seagram could not be reached immediately for comment.
